text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for traffic calming (speed humps) on Walpole Avenue, between Greenwood Avenue and Hiawatha Road. The assessment indicates the warrant criteria as set out in the City of Toronto's Traffic Calming Policy has not been satisfied. Therefore, staff do not recommend the installation of speed humps on Walpole Avenue.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until the June 29, 2022 meeting of the Toronto and East York Community Council.
